Pet Grooming Marketing Agency | More Bookings | TailWerks [Skip to content](https://tailwerks.com/industries/pet-grooming-marketing-agency/#content "Skip to content") Marketing for grooming businesses # Pet Grooming _Marketing Agency_ More of the right appointments. More reasons to come back. Help local pet owners find you, understand your services, and book their next groom. TailWerks works with grooming salons, mobile groomers, and franchises to improve local visibility, booking paths, and follow-up around the capacity you actually have. [Check Availability in Your Area →](https://tailwerks.com/check-availability/)[Compare pricing →](https://tailwerks.com/industries/pet-grooming-marketing-agency/#twgm-paths) Suitable new clientsClear booking pathsMore consistent rebooking ![Groomer greeting a pet owner and apricot poodle at a grooming salon](https://tailwerks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/pet-grooming-marketing-salon-welcome.jpg) A better first visit starts here Where to start ## Which part of the calendar _needs attention?_ **The phone rings while you are grooming** Missed calls need a clear response path. A missed-call text and shared inbox can help your team pick up the conversation when it can respond. **The calendar is busy, but the appointments do not fit** Your website and ads should explain the pets, services, and areas you accept so your team spends less time untangling unsuitable requests. **Good clients leave without their next visit** Make rebooking part of the process. Supported follow-up can use your approved schedule and available appointment data to prompt the next conversation. **A quiet day turns into a last-minute scramble** Plan around known capacity and seasonal changes. Promote services you can deliver, and review what is happening between the inquiry and the confirmed groom. Your business model matters ## A salon, a mobile route, _or several locations_ ### Grooming salons Help clients find the right location, understand your services and starting prices, and request a visit that suits your groomers and available time. ### Mobile groomers Target the neighborhoods you serve. Explain your travel area, accepted pets, and booking process before an inquiry reaches you. Route planning remains a separate operational decision. ### Groups and franchises Connect the brand with each location. Agree local campaigns, approvals, booking paths, and reporting around the people responsible for each salon or territory. What we do for groomers ## Get found. Make booking clearer. _Support the next visit._ ### Search advertising for groomers Foundation and up Reach pet owners looking for the grooming you actually offer. Google Ads campaigns can focus on full grooms, bath-and-brush visits, puppy introductions, or cat grooming where available. We match the area and message to your appointment capacity. For mobile businesses, that starts with the neighborhoods you can realistically serve. Local Services Ads management applies where your business is eligible. [Explore paid advertising →](https://tailwerks.com/services/paid-advertising/) ### Local SEO and a clearer grooming website Foundation and up Help nearby owners understand your services, pricing approach, pet requirements, and how to request a visit. Foundation covers core local SEO, Google Business Profile work, local listings, and a complete website build within the agreed scope. Salon locations and mobile service areas need different information. Booking links use the paths your software supports. [Explore local SEO →](https://tailwerks.com/services/search-engine-optimization/)[Explore website development →](https://tailwerks.com/services/web-development/) ### Missed calls, follow-up, and the next groom Essentials; included in Scale When your hands are busy, an unanswered call should still have a next step. Essentials supports missed-call text-back, a shared inbox, and approved routine replies. With the required appointment and pet data, it can also support reminders, review requests, rebooking, and lapsed-client follow-up. Your team handles conversations and confirms appointments. [Explore Essentials →](https://tailwerks.com/packages/essentials/) ### Social media that shows your work Growth and up Turn approved before-and-after photos, groomer introductions, and service education into coordinated Facebook and Instagram advertising and managed social content. Growth also adds expanded SEO content, link building, and ongoing website improvements. Your team supplies usable photos or footage and approves the facts, pet-owner permissions, and offers. [Explore managed social media →](https://tailwerks.com/services/social-media/) ### Advanced conversations and routing Scale, after six months on Growth For established Growth clients, Scale adds approved routine AI phone support, advanced conversations, routing, and custom workflows. A cancellation or waitlist workflow needs reliable availability, suitable pet details, and a clear staff handoff. We confirm those connections before building. The Essentials service scope is included in Scale, with usage and applicable third-party charges separate. [Explore Scale →](https://tailwerks.com/packages/scale/) ### Example: making room for the right appointments A salon with weekday bath-and-brush capacity could align its ads and service page, explain accepted pets and starting prices, and track inquiries through the booking decision. With Essentials added and suitable data available, approved follow-up could support the next visit. This is an illustration of the work, not a client result or a forecast. ### What would make your next month easier? Tell us whether you need more suitable clients, clearer follow-up, or a plan for another location. We will review your market and talk through the fit. [Check Availability in Your Area →](https://tailwerks.com/check-availability/) Pricing for grooming businesses ## Choose the right level of _marketing and follow-up._ Foundation, Growth, and Scale build on one another. Essentials can run on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth for $297/month per location. Its service scope is included in the private Scale quote, with no separate Essentials management fee.
